subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Climate Risk and Finance
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Climate Risk and Finance.

hook.text: Insurers are pulling out of wildfire zones. Some areas are becoming completely uninsurable.

buildup.text: Climate change makes extreme weather more frequent, breaking models built on historical data.

discovery.text: The TCFD now requires companies to disclose climate risks to investors.

twist.text: Climate risk isn't just environmental. It's financial, operational, and reputational — all at once.

climax.text: The biggest threat to 21st-century business may be the planet itself.

punchline.text: The planet is the risk. Past data won't help.

quiz.question: Why is climate change breaking actuarial models?
options: Extreme weather exceeds what historical data predicts
